premium.note: Stage-2 job P, PREMIUM (credit/carry) structures: every stage-1-profitable credit or carry structure the O_STYLE builder supports (O_CSP, O_BULLPS, O_JL, O_RS, O_WHEEL, O_CC, O_PP, O_IC). Approved by the owner 2026-11-04. Member order is precedence (first passing rule wins; one structure per underlying): WHEEL first (owner 2026-11-04: oversold strong large caps you are happy to own -- the CSP entry that HOLDS its assignment and writes covered calls), CSP (the same put sale, stock sold at the next open; takes the names the wheel gate refuses; owner idea: sell a put after a pullback expecting a rebound -- the pullback gate is seeded ON by the seed policy, never forced here), BULLPS (defined-risk bullish credit), JL and RS (skewed credit), CC and PP (stock + call/put overlay in round lots), IC last (neutral, joint entry mode, only HOLD signals reach it). DTE: every option-entry member searches a centre range 12..30 step 2 around an authored 15..29 window (half-width 7), so the decoded window is centre +/- 7 = 5..37 days and never starts below 5. O_CC/O_PP calls/puts and the wheel's covered call are exit overlays whose DTE (centre 20..60, half-width 10, so min 10) the spec cannot move. Full-notional members (CSP, WHEEL, JL, RS) search option_sizing 5..100 so one contract can use all the cash (budget = min(option_sizing, per-instrument cap)). No price cap. The $20k equity cap is a launch flag. O_VERT left out: debit bear put vertical (stage-1 fitness 0.088), the debit family is job A's. Risk block: undefined_risk_max_pct fixed 100 because a cash-secured put is classed as undefined risk (naked sub-cap) and charges its full strike*100 to it; 0 would refuse every CSP/JL/RS/WHEEL entry. The real limits are the searched max_deployment_pct, the per-instrument cap, and the assignment-cash rail.

long.note: Stage-2 job C, LONG horizon (docs/plans/2026-09-25-option-stage2-plan.md section 0.2 C). Approved by the owner 2026-11-04. Expert = DeterministicScorer only; the $20k equity cap is a launch flag; no price cap (entries are bounded by risk sizing and the option risk manager); every condition stays togglable (no gate is forced on here). Members: O_CBS (call backspread, authored DTE 80..140, the shortest horizon of the style), O_LEAP (deep-ITM long call/put LEAPS, stock replacement), O_PMCC (poor man's covered call: LEAPS plus a short call), O_CONVEX (OTM convex call/put lottery). Member order is precedence, first passing rule wins, one structure per underlying. Rationale: CBS first (best stage-1.5 fitness 34.8, defined risk, shortest capital lock); LEAP is the core stock replacement; PMCC third (the LEAP-plus-income variant, takes the names the LEAP gate refuses); CONVEX LAST because it is a lottery arm whose stage-1.5 winners are concentrated (GOOG+PLTR 45-65% of P&L, top-1 trade 25-34%) and must not pre-empt the higher-conviction structures. O_LEAP, O_PMCC and O_CONVEX carry no action_overrides: they are _STYLE_DTE_INVARIANT_MEMBERS (a LEAPS opens at >= 365 DTE against its own exit band), so their authored DTE (380..470, 300..420) stays; O_CBS keeps its authored band too (80..140 sits in the plan's 90-180 range). O_PBS is OUT (its stage-1.5 run failed: no bearish signals on large caps). Risk block = job A's rails (classic_options, 20 concurrent, undefined_risk_max_pct 0: none of these members is an undefined-risk candidate, only short_put/short_strangle are). The per-instrument cap is NOT widened (5..25): the stage-1.5 convex winners are concentrated, and at $20k it also means a deep-ITM LEAPS on a high-priced name may not fit one cap slice and is refused by the sizing rail, which is intended pressure rather than a bug.

long10k.note: Stage-2 job L10 (owner 2026-11-08): MAX-PROFIT long option book for a $10k account; the $10k initial capital and equity cap are launch flags. Members chosen by one-lot cost at $10k (stage-1/1.5/2 trade records, 1-lot entry cost median / p90): O_LC (30-60 DTE) $330-520 / $0.7-2.1k, O_BULLCS $90-205 / $0.5-0.8k, O_CONVEX $345 / $680, O_LEAP $1.6k / $4.6k. Left out: O_PMCC and O_CBS (lost money in stage 1.5 and job C, $1.2-2k a lot), O_STRD / O_STRG (volatility, not the long book asked for), O_BF (weak). Member order is precedence, first passing rule wins: the cheap, frequent structures first and O_LEAP LAST, so a LEAPS refused by the sizing rail (one lot = 15-45% of $10k) never blocks a cheaper member on that name. structure_share 20..80 step 10 per member (job C used 20..60): at $10k a 20% share is $2k, about one median LEAPS lot, so a member may take most of the book. O_LC / O_BULLCS keep job A's DTE overrides; O_CONVEX / O_LEAP are DTE-invariant members (authored bands). Risk = job C's block with the per-instrument cap widened to 10..40 (a 5% slice is $500: most LC / LEAP lots would be refused) and deployment 30..90. Fitness option_long_dd40_50 (owner 2026-11-08: drawdown free to 40%, 0 at 50%).
